title: SwaftyGT'S Texture Pack
description: This Is SwaftyGT'S PVP Texture Pack For Sword, mace, Spear Mace, And crystal
body:
## Welcome to the Ultimate SwaftyGT Purple PVP Pack!

This is my custom PvP texture pack designed specifically to make competitive fights cleaner, faster, and much better looking. If you are tired of default textures blocking your screen or looking generic during intense duels, this pack is exactly what you need. 

### What’s Inside:
* **Custom Weapons:** Sleek, short-style purple swords for better visibility, a completely redesigned mace, and a unique spear mace variant.
* **Crystal & Items:** Clean, glowing End Crystals, obsidian blocks, and stylized totals to keep your hotbar look unified and sharp.
* **Projectiles & Consumables:** A clean purple bow, matching arrows, and custom purple-themed golden apples (gapples) and chorus fruit.
* **Armor & Elytra:** Full matching purple armor sets (helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots) along with custom broken and unbroken Elytra wings.

Whether you are playing competitive survival, standard PvP, or just practicing your crystal setups, this pack gives you a huge aesthetic upgrade without dropping your FPS. Download it, try it out, and let me know what you think in the comments!
